ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixel ratio is extremely low, with black pixels occupying >95% of the visible fluke surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous solid low-intensity (black) saturation across the entirety of both lobes; isolated, sparse clusters of high-intensity pixels (white specks) are localized on the medial section of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped median notch with a calculated internal angle of approximately 105 degrees and a moderate bounding-box depth relative to the total fluke width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations (peaks and valleys) along the entire trailing edge boundary, with maximum pixel-amplitude variations detected at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Continuous convex curvature along the trailing edge, transitioning into a localized upward concave sweep at the distal-most tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of multiple discrete, roughly circular high-contrast pixel clusters (white on black background) on the left lobe surface, consistent with focal scarring.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Detection of an irregular, high-contrast pixel cluster and physical protrusion on the distal tip of the left lobe lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Uniformly dark pigmentation (Type 5) across the visible ventral surface.
